title: TOPMAX: fast genomic prediction and multi-trait selection for large breeding populations
description: TOPMAX is a fast and memory-efficient tool for genomic prediction (ridge regression with randomized SVD, generalized cross-validation and warm-started conjugate gradient, without a genomic relationship matrix) and target-oriented multi-trait selection (trait weights learned with mini-batch AdamW). This archive also contains the scripts and source data that reproduce the figures of the accompanying manuscript.
